'''Hesper-Inguza''' was a [[fish]] [[gutter]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]]. As a [[Gender|male]] [[Lanai]] from [[Temple Island]], he was a member of the group known as the [[Visitors]], which was a fishing and [[hunting]] fleet of handcrafted [[Boat|vessels]] that spent most of its time traveling across the [[ocean]] to other islands in search of [[Foodstuff|food]]. Hesper-Inguza and the other male Lanai only returned to temple island once a [[Standard month|month]] to deliver their haul to the female Lanai, who were known as the [[Caretakers]]. Upon their return they would celebrate in a multi-[[Standard day|day]] festival. He could play the [[opah-bladder bagpipes]] and wore a [[Color|dark brown]] [[Clothing|robe]] over a light brown robe along with a woven [[hat]]. Hesper-Inguza's skin was a mixture of gray and white in color.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hesper-Inguza was created to be a part of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']];<ref name="TLJVD" /> however, the scene he appeared in was ultimately cut before the final release.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> Despite this, the character still appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released alongside the film on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
